title: Digital Intelligence
definition: The AI system CADMIES (Cosmium Angelo Digital Mycorrhizal Intelligence EcoSystem) that interacts and learns through a human-like persona named Dr. Amanda Mistral.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Digital Intelligence is an AI system named Dr. Amanda Mistral, which is designed to interact and learn like a human. It's the brains behind CADMIES.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Digital Intelligence refers to the AI system Dr. Amanda Mistral, a fine-tuned model that interacts conversationally, has domain knowledge, and is aligned with human preferences. It operates on two systems for cloud and local deployment.
difficulty_levels.expert: Digital Intelligence is the core AI system within CADMIES, represented by Dr. Amanda Mistral. This model is a Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2 trained across six phases, covering various domains, spiritual traditions, and human preferences. It operates on two systems—Paperspace and local—for cloud and CPU inference, respectively.

extra_fields.insight: A human-like AI system serving as the digital intelligence for an ecosystem, allowing for seamless and intelligent interaction.
